# Pawpath Waitlist

## Executive Summary

Pawpath is replacing a manual, phone-based paper waitlist with an automated SMS system that instantly offers freed appointment slots to matched pet owners. When a cancellation occurs, the system identifies the first qualifying owner on the waitlist, sends an SMS offer, and holds the slot for 15 minutes (per the PM's specification) pending confirmation. This delivers value across all three user groups: pet owners gain faster, friction-free access to earlier appointments; front-desk staff eliminate outbound call queues; and clinic managers gain visibility into demand that paper lists cannot provide. The stories below cover four epics — Waitlist Registration, Slot Matching & Notification, Slot Claiming & Hold, and Staff & Clinic Management — with identified gaps and recommendations included.

---

## Gap Analysis & Expert Recommendations

Before stories, the following **critical gaps** must be resolved with the PM:

- **Matching logic undefined:** "First matching owner" requires explicit criteria (appointment type, preferred vet, pet species/breed, geographic location, date/time window). **Recommendation:** Define a matching ruleset before sprint 1.
- **Secondary offer flow missing:** What happens if the first owner does not respond in 15 minutes? The system must cascade to the next owner. This story is included below as an assumption.
- **Waitlist join channel unspecified:** No input on whether owners join via app, web, SMS keyword, or in-clinic kiosk. **Assumption: owners join via a web form link** — label this as a target to validate.
- **SMS opt-in/consent absent:** Regulatory compliance (e.g., TCPA-equivalent) requires explicit opt-in. Stories include this.
- **Integration context missing:** No mention of an existing clinic management system (PMS). **Assumption: Pawpath has an internal slot inventory API** — confirm before backend design.
- **Waitlist capacity and priority rules undefined:** E.g., FIFO vs. urgency-weighted. Stories assume FIFO; flag for PM decision.

---

## Epic 1: Waitlist Registration

### US-01 — Join the Waitlist
**As a pet owner, I want to register my pet on the clinic's waitlist via a web form, so that I can be automatically considered for freed appointment slots.**

```gherkin
Given I have received or found the clinic's waitlist link
When I submit the form with my name, mobile number, pet name,
     appointment type, preferred vet (optional), and
     earliest/latest acceptable dates
Then I receive a confirmation SMS with a summary of my preferences
 And I am added to the FIFO waitlist for that clinic
 And my record shows status "Active"
```

### US-02 — SMS Opt-In Consent
**As a pet owner, I want to explicitly opt in to SMS notifications, so that I only receive messages I have agreed to.**

```gherkin
Given I have submitted the waitlist form
When the confirmation SMS arrives with "Reply YES to opt in"
Then my status changes to "SMS Confirmed" only after I reply YES
 And if I do not reply YES within 24 hours, my status is set
     to "Pending Consent" and no slot offers are sent
```

### US-03 — Remove Myself from the Waitlist
**As a pet owner, I want to cancel my waitlist position at any time, so that I do not receive unwanted slot offers after my need has passed.**

```gherkin
Given I am on the active waitlist
When I reply STOP to any Pawpath SMS
 Or I click the cancellation link in my confirmation SMS
Then my status changes to "Removed" within 60 seconds
 And I receive a confirmation SMS that I have been removed
 And no further SMS offers are sent to me for that clinic
```

---

## Epic 2: Slot Matching & Notification

### US-04 — Automatic Match on Cancellation
**As a front-desk staff member, I want the system to automatically identify the first matching waitlisted owner when a slot is freed, so that I do not need to make manual calls.**

```gherkin
Given a booked appointment is cancelled in the system
When the slot becomes available
Then the system queries the active waitlist within 30 seconds
     (Target: ≤30 seconds — assumption to validate)
 And selects the earliest FIFO entry whose appointment type,
     preferred vet (if set), and date window match the freed slot
 And logs the match event with a timestamp
```

### US-05 — SMS Slot Offer to Owner
**As a pet owner, I want to receive an SMS the moment a matching slot is freed, so that I can decide quickly without waiting for a phone call.**

```gherkin
Given a matching waitlisted owner has been identified
When the system sends the slot offer SMS
Then the message includes the clinic name, date, time,
     vet name, and a reply instruction ("Reply CLAIM to book")
 And the slot is placed on a 15-minute hold for that owner
 And no other owner is offered the same slot during the hold
```

---

## Epic 3: Slot Claiming & Hold

### US-06 — Claim a Slot by SMS Reply
**As a pet owner, I want to claim a freed slot by replying CLAIM, so that I can book the appointment without calling the clinic.**

```gherkin
Given I have received an SMS slot offer
 And the 15-minute hold has not expired
When I reply CLAIM
Then my appointment is confirmed and recorded in the system
 And I receive a booking confirmation SMS with full appointment details
 And my waitlist status changes to "Booked"
 And the hold is released
```

### US-07 — Hold Expiry & Cascade to Next Owner
**As a pet owner next on the waitlist, I want to be offered a slot if the first owner does not claim it, so that freed slots are never wasted.**

```gherkin
Given a slot is on 15-minute hold for the first matched owner
When 15 minutes elapse without a CLAIM reply
Then the hold is released
 And the system identifies the next matching owner in FIFO order
 And sends that owner an SMS offer for the same slot
 And this cascade repeats until the slot is claimed or
     the waitlist is exhausted
 And if no owner claims it, the slot reverts to "Available"
     and front-desk staff receive an in-app alert
```

### US-08 — Decline a Slot Offer
**As a pet owner, I want to decline a slot offer without losing my waitlist position, so that I am not penalised for a slot that doesn't suit me.**

```gherkin
Given I have received an SMS slot offer
When I reply SKIP
Then the hold is released immediately
 And my waitlist status remains "Active"
 And I remain in my FIFO position for future offers
 And the system cascades to the next matching owner
```

---

## Epic 4: Staff & Clinic Management

### US-09 — View and Manage the Live Waitlist
**As a front-desk staff member, I want to view the current waitlist and manually trigger an offer, so that I can handle edge cases the automation cannot.**

```gherkin
Given I am logged in to the Pawpath staff dashboard
When I navigate to the Waitlist panel
Then I see all active waitlist entries ordered by FIFO position
     with owner name, pet name, appointment type, and date window
When I select an entry and click "Send Offer"
Then the system sends an SMS offer and starts the 15-minute hold
 And the action is logged with my staff ID and timestamp
```

### US-10 — Waitlist Performance Dashboard for Managers
**As a clinic manager, I want to view weekly waitlist metrics, so that I can identify demand patterns and adjust scheduling capacity.**

```gherkin
Given I am logged in with manager-level access
When I open the Waitlist Analytics view and select a date range
Then I see: total waitlist joins, slots offered, slots claimed,
     slots expired (hold timeout), and average time-to-claim
 And I can filter by appointment type and vet
 And I can export the data as a CSV file
```

---

## INVEST Check

| Story | I | N | V | E | S | T | Rating | Action |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| US-01 Join Waitlist | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ✅ | Good | **Split** web-form fields from join logic if form is complex |
| US-02 SMS Opt-In | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Strong | — |
| US-03 Remove Self | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Strong | — |
| US-04 Auto Match | ⚠️ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | ✅ | **Rework** | Depends on matching ruleset (gap); estimability low until rules defined |
| US-05 SMS Offer | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Strong | — |
| US-06 Claim Slot | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Strong | — |
| US-07 Hold Expiry | ⚠️ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Good | Shares dependency with US-04/05; sequence carefully in sprint |
| US-08 Decline Offer | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Strong | — |
| US-09 Staff View | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ✅ | Good | **Split** view-only story from manual-trigger story |
| US-10 Analytics | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ✅ | Good | **Split** display metrics from CSV export as separate story |

**Stories requiring action before sprint planning:**
- **US-04** — block until matching ruleset is agreed; too ambiguous to estimate reliably
- **US-09** — split into US-09a (read-only list view) and US-09b (manual offer trigger)
- **US-10** — split into US-10a (dashboard display) and US-10b (CSV export)

---

## Next Steps

1. **Resolve matching logic (blocker):** Schedule a PM + engineering session this week to define all matching criteria (appointment type, vet, date window, species). US-04 and US-07 cannot be estimated without this.
2. **Confirm waitlist join channel:** Validate the assumption that owners join via a web form link before any front-end work begins.
3. **Identify PMS integration:** Confirm whether Pawpath has an existing slot inventory API or whether one must be built; this drives the sprint 1 backend scope.
4. **Legal review for SMS consent:** Share US-02 with legal/compliance to confirm the opt-in flow meets applicable regulations before build starts.
5. **Split US-09 and US-10** as noted in the INVEST Check, then re-estimate all stories in a sizing session with the development team.
6. **Prioritise MVP scope:** Stories US-01 through US-07 form the minimum viable flow; US-08, US-09, and US-10 are enhancement tier — confirm this sequencing with stakeholders.
